# Get grade and grader tail
grade_results = await CONTEXT.search("[grade]")
for r in grade_results['items']:
    print("GRADE:", r['snippet'])
    print()
    # Read around this area
    text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, r['offset']-200), 600)
    print("AROUND GRADE:")
    print(text)
    print()

# Get grader tail
gt_results = await CONTEXT.search("[grader tail]")
for r in gt_results['items']:

    print()
    text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, r['offset']-100), 1000)
    print("AROUND GRADER TAIL:")
    print(text)

for r in facts_results['items']:

    print("AROUND FACTS:")
